# symbolic system kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/symbolicSystemKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of a symbolic system ([`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md) values). Non-functional — a system may serve multiple domains simultaneously.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) -> [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md) from [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) to [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md), [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag a symbolic system with the domain(s) it serves — mathematical, musical, stenographic, emoji, gesture — asserting as many as apply, since one system may span several.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the role a notation plays in a particular use (that is [`gmeow:notationUsageRole`](gmeow-notationUsageRole.md)) and avoid making it functional; a system serving multiple domains states multiple kinds rather than collapsing them.

### How to use

- Point the system at one or more seeded [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md) individuals; for a system already typed [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) prefer the [`gmeow:notationSystemKind`](gmeow-notationSystemKind.md) subproperty so the narrower domain is explicit.

### Examples

- ex:braille [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md) [`gmeow:symbolicKindTranscription`](../individuals/gmeow-symbolicKindTranscription.md), [`gmeow:symbolicKindEncoding`](../individuals/gmeow-symbolicKindEncoding.md).
